title: Token Beacon: compact role-aware export & pricing microflow
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Product teams need a compact, shareable view that ties per-invocation token footprints to price bands and allows role-aware exports for finance, engineering, and PMs. Current Console exports are verbose CSVs and lack an opinionated UI to create repeatable export templates or quickly surface anomalous spend by token slice.

Objective: Design a lightweight Console panel — 'Token Beacon' — that sits on the cost dashboard and lets users: 1) run focused token-level queries, 2) preview pricing mapping per-row (rateband + discounts), 3) create role-scoped export templates (CSV/Parquet) with sanitized columns, and 4) surface quick remediation actions (pin prompt set, create alert, suggested quantization).

Scope: High-fidelity prototype for the panel, export template UX, role-permission variations (viewer/finance/analyst), CSV/Parquet schema recommendation, accessibility pass, and a short handoff spec for ENG + PM. Not in scope: backend export pipeline work or billing ingestion changes (separate ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes: compact token-sparkline row, expandable attribution detail, pricing badges for rateband and applied discount
Export modal supports saved templates and role-specific column sets; template creation flow validated with PM
Design tokens and spacing adhere to Console system; color contrast and keyboard flows pass accessibility checks
Handoff doc lists CSV/Parquet schema (column names + example rows), sample API params for export, and pagination strategy for large exports
Design-reviewed by PM (Asha) and Engineering lead (Evan Rodriguez) and changes captured in comments
comments: 2026-02-16 - Marco Li: Created initial wireframes. Focused on a compact list view with per-row actions. Flagging complexity around rateband logic when multiple discounts apply.
2026-02-20 - Asha Patel: Reviewed wireframes; asked for quick action to 'pin prompt set' and an 'explain cost' tooltip for non-finance viewers.
2026-02-25 - Evan Rodriguez: ENG review — backend can expose per-token billing rows but will need pagination + streaming export hook. Suggest adding an export sampling option for huge time ranges.
2026-03-02 - Marco Li: Iterated prototype to include role toggles (Viewer/Finance/Analyst) and template editor. Added examples for sanitized columns (PII removed for Viewer role).
2026-03-05 - Design crit (all-hands): Feedback to reduce visual noise — convert large badges to microchips and introduce an affordance to pin rows to a 'watchlist'.
2026-03-09 - Asha Patel: PM sign-off on scope; requested one more accessibility pass and CSV schema review from Billing team.
2026-03-10 - Evan Rodriguez: Engineering accepted design with two follow-ups: (1) ENG-45902 for streaming export API contract, (2) ENG-45903 for server-side rateband mapping edge cases.
prototype_notes: Compact list defaults to last 24h, with sticky filters for model, route, and user role
Each row: prompt-hash label (short), tokens-in/out sparkline (mini SVG), unit-cost badge, effective-rateband tag, and a 3-dot menu for row actions
Expand-on-click reveals attribution columns (session id, route, model-version, quantization flag) and a visual mapping to pricing bands
Export template editor: drag-to-order columns, toggle visibility by role, and add 'sanitization rules' to mask or drop PII columns
Support 'Export Preview' that streams first 100 rows so users can validate schema before committing the full export
